node.statement: By the lemma's hypothesis, every nonactor support fiber Q satisfies at least one of the two conditions: (i) p_Q in conv{p_v,p_w,p_f,p_z,p_o}, or (ii) 0 <= y_Q <= 1. The hypothesis supplies this as an inclusive disjunction.
